chunks: And in the narration of Ṭalḥah ibn Zayd, from Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad, from his father, peace be upon him, who said:
ʿAlī, peace be upon him, said: “The right of pre-emption is according to the number of men.”

key_terms.أَبِيهِ: his father, referring to the preceding Imam in the chain
key_terms.الرِّجَالِ: the men, meaning the male claimants or participants in this legal context
key_terms.الشُّفْعَةُ: the right of pre-emption in jointly owned or adjacent property

ai.seo_question: How is the right of pre-emption divided among multiple claimants in Islamic law?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling concerning shufʿah, the right of pre-emption in shared property. It indicates that this right is determined in accordance with the number of men involved, making it relevant to questions of ownership shares and legal claims among partners.
